payload.text: Journal snapshot framing safety (deliverable: journal-durability). frame_snapshot is a pure, deterministic framing function: given (watermark, snap_len, snapshot) it emits sync-word + snapshot-marker + little-endian watermark/len + snapshot bytes + trailing CRC-32 with no I/O and no side effect, sharing the identical crc32 trailer discipline as the record path so the two framings cannot drift. Determinism guarantees the recovery reader's recomputed CRC matches bit-for-bit, rejecting any torn snapshot tail on replay. Pure (no WRITES edges); self-invalidates on code change.
